description: Wallets an official source lists (OFAC SDN list, FBI / IC3 announcements, official incident post-mortems), each as "Listed as <category> by <source>, <date>" with a link. With an address: its listings, balances and tracked on-chain movements (404 when it is not listed). The other side of a movement is never labelled by us.

address.description: One address (EVM, Bitcoin, Tron …): its listings and movements.

limit.description: Number of wallets or movements (default 10, at most 50).

network.description: Only this address family (evm, bitcoin, tron …).

source.description: Only this source: ofac_sdn, fbi_ic3 or incident.

name: get_listed_wallets
title: Listed wallets
